newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB-120 index rises 1.1 points to 731.4 pts.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB-120 index rises 1.1 points to 731.4 pts.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, rose 1.1 points on Monday to 731.4 points, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Six of the ten sectoral indices rose, with the investment fund index rising the most, up 21.1 points to 1,053.7.
Four indices lost, with the banking index losing the most, down 7.6 points to 1,139.2
